'''2007 Worlds Team Team Awesome LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Team Awesome]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Player name blacked out; Team Awesome. Deck title HB. Shields include systems (Hidden Base suite).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Team Awesome]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
